IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. UFMXDBL.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
P.
    COMPUTE L-R = L-X * 2.
    GOBACK.
END FUNCTION UFMXDBL.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. UFMX1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION UFMXDBL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W = FUNCTION UFMXDBL(21).
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM UFMX1.
